model.pool: Within one grade, pool = (teams that school fields in that grade) × 8. 4th grade, 5/6, and Cadet are separate pools.
model.slices: Where a grade has A, B, and C, A takes the top of the pool, then B, then C. Teams in the same letter start equal. A grade with no letter starts every team at 1500.
model.scale: A one-team school starts at 1500. The best 8 of a 32-girl pool start 100 points higher.
model.update: A 2-1 between even teams is ±24 points. A 2-0 is ±36.
model.sos: SOS is the average final rating of the opponents played.
